body:
A build records what it read from the machine, beyond its own copy of the source:

- environment variables,
- files outside the project,
- tools found on `PATH`.

The record is kept with the release. Tool versions are already recorded (D-247), so they aren't repeated.

If some of this can't be recorded reliably, say what can't and why, and propose the decision rather than guessing.

Done when: a build that reads an environment variable, a file outside the project and a tool on `PATH` has all three in its release record.
title: inspection: record what a build read
